evidence.title: Account Access And MFA
evidence.text: If the account owner cannot be verified, the case must be escalated for human identity review. The assistant must not disable MFA directly.

evidence.title: Account Access And MFA
evidence.text: For multi-factor authentication lockouts, support should verify the customer email, confirm the account owner, and check whether backup codes were already issued. The assistant may draft a reset checklist only after customer context matches the ticket requester.
